title: Mountain long run, 2h15 / ~600m D+
terrain: mountain trail (Presolana or Lecco pre-alps), ~600m D+, run the descents
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 2h15, ~600m D+ (450m if Tue-Thu had any knee signal). Z2 145-155 bulk, one 15min climb at 160-166 (stop at 15min), descend at 172+ spm.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 flask Tailwind (500ml, 2 scoops) from min 20, 1 Carbo Gel at 1h30.
STOP RULE: HRV under 60 or RHR over 51, drop the climb and cut to 1h45.
WHY: restores the mountain stimulus lost to Monza; descents trained for VWT's last 8km.
